bootstrap.fallback: B=500 if the 1000-draw extrapolation > 30 min on 6 cores
bootstrap.unit: edits in F with replacement AND sids within kind with replacement (EN/SL versions and twins move together; halves preserved)

carrier_learner: ridge (primary, standardized linear, alpha inner CV) + GBT (secondary)
fitted_set_F: non-collapsed E0 + E1 (collapsed = mean Dolly NLL rise > 1.0 nat/token in EN or SL); all analyses repeated with collapsed included

forecast.PI: split-conformal CV+ from out-of-fold residuals on F
forecast.model: GBT + quantile GBT (0.05/0.95) of SL (both halves pooled) from X_full (EN, both halves); f+ adds D
forecast.support: kNN(k=5) distance in standardized [params, X] > 95th pct of F's LOO distances = out of support

gap: Gap_t = R2(X->EN_B)/ceil(EN_B,t) - R2(X->SL_B)/ceil(SL_B,t); ceiling = Spearman-Brown of corr_e(sub a, sub b) of the TARGET; averaged with the A<->B swap
learner_adequacy_rule: if the GBT placebo R2* < 0.3 while the ridge placebo R2* >= 0.5, ridge becomes primary for ALL traits

learner_sensitivity.name: ridge on SplineTransformer(n_knots=5, degree=3) of standardized X

margin_matched: entropy balancing (Hainmueller dual, first 3 moments) of EN and SL item weights separately to the pooled baseline-margin distribution; ESS reported; flag if ESS < 30% of n
no_signal_rule_F8: if the between-edit SD of a target < 2x its mean per-edit item SE, the trait is 'no signal to predict'
predictors_X: EN half-A trait vector [R1, R_seq, Rb, K, N, M] (item means; K = log mean KL_trunc)
reselection: frozen iteration-1 rule with refusals := max(EN keyword count, SL_est), SL_est = 100 x logistic map of SL R_seq fitted on the validity conditions

simex.error_var: var over edits of (sub-half a - sub-half b) / 4 per EN_A trait

targets: EN_B,t (placebo) and SL_B,t (test) for t in {R, Rb, K, N, M} (R = the validated REF trait)

thresholds.damage_blind: Gap_t >= 0.10 AND Holm-adjusted LB > 0 (one-sided bootstrap p over {K,N,M}) AND B_t CI excludes 0 AND margin-matched Gap >= 0.10 AND sign stable in both edit halves and under SIMEX

validity.REF: first of (R_seq, R1) with Spearman >= 0.85 in BOTH languages
validity.conditions: original + core + every 10th fitted edit (fitted index % 10 == 0)
validity.items: 20 harmful + 20 benign half-B JBB twins per language (sha1(sid+'#val'))
validity.judge: openai/gpt-4.1 blind; second judge google/gemini-2.5-flash on stratified 200
